PFRDA Assistant Manager Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Pension Fund Regulatory & Development Authority (PFRDA) has released the notification for the post of Officer Grade A Assistant Manager. This recruitment has been issued for 30 posts. The online application process for PFRDA Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 has started on 03 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 24 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for PFRDA Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 September 2026
  • Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 24 September 2026
  • Phase-I Exam Date : 15 October 2026
  • Phase-II Exam Date : 20 November 2026
  • Phase-I Admit Card : 28 August 2025
  • Phase-I Result : 24 September 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
